# /crav1-bundle-to-specs

lane: specify | group: Start | starter: yes | stage: stable | since: 1.0.0 | prompts: 2
purpose: Turn mixed intake (notes, diagrams, screenshots, optional code as context) into docs/system/ (including glossary.md) plus one spec slug per v0 feature.
use_when: Mixed files, or several v0 features
reads: Reads the intake files.
writes: Writes `docs/system/` including `glossary.md` (a missing glossary and new rows when the folder already exists), one `docs/specs/<slug>/` per confirmed v0 feature, the landscape index, `work-item.md` on an Azure Repos opt-in, and `docs/sources/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/` when an intake file it quotes is an imported source, following `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/sources.md`. That check may write the transfer data policy after a yes. Cursor: `.cursor/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.mdc`. Claude Code project: `.claude/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.md`. It never writes a secrets choice into that file. A mail is written as text, `mail.md`, and the original mail stays outside the repo. For a mail, it lists each embedded image, inline or attached. It recommends convert to text when the image is a diagram, a table, or text that can be reproduced exactly, and compress otherwise. It asks once before the source folder is written. Auto-accept applies to those recommendations only when the transfer data policy clearly covers them. Where it reads a whole repo, sets that repo's `Synced at` line in `repos.md` and touches only those repos. Where it reads only one slice, leaves the repos.md Synced at lines alone and writes or updates `Synced at: <repo> <branch>@<short sha>, <date>` on that slice's `spec.md`.
leaves alone: Leaves application code, `plan.md`, and later slices alone. Does not commit.
limits: prompts `/crav1-finalize-commit` and does not run it. A quoted note in `docs/notes/` gets its slug in `used_by` and a `Full source:` link; notes are never absorbed.
flow:
- Mixed intake → `docs/system/` (including `glossary.md`) + one spec per v0 feature (isolated slice workers).
- A missing `glossary.md` is filled when the folder already exists.
- A meaning the source does not state is `to be researched`.
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls `/crav1-create-feature-branch` when the repo already has commits.
you run next: /crav1-create-feature-branch; /crav1-review-architecture; /crav1-tighten-spec; /crav1-finalize-commit
first: `/crav1-bundle-to-specs @notes/overview.md @sketches/flow.png @legacy-api/ <optional sentence: new system, that code is context — or extract-as-is> Treat hunches as proposed, not decided. Do not write code. Map first, then landscape, then one spec per v0 slug.`
walkthrough: from-bundle-to-specs.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.210.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-bundle-to-specs.md
